title: Security: threat model, TLS, key management, spam mitigation spikes
description: Security hardening for the usenet-ipfs system. Covers: threat model document, TLS on NNTP, operator key lifecycle (generation, rotation, backup), spam mitigation evaluation (PoW vs rate-limited signing), and an NNTP input validation coverage audit. All NNTP input is treated as attacker-controlled. Signing keys are never logged.
